app.title: BioGenius: RNA-Seq differential expression
app.summary: A person uploads a count matrix and a sample metadata table, or loads a bundled demo set, then picks the metadata column to compare on, the target group and the reference group, and runs a DESeq2 fit. Each feature gets a fold change and an adjusted p-value, and is called up, down or not significant against fold-change and p-value cutoffs set in the sidebar. The calls show as totals and as a volcano plot with the cutoffs drawn in, both of which update as the cutoffs move. The full results table can be downloaded as CSV.

task.text: Test every gene for a difference in expression between two groups of samples and pick out the ones that pass fold-change and significance cutoffs.

data.text: A matrix of raw read counts, features as rows and samples as columns, with a table of sample metadata giving each sample's group.
data.item: a gene, with its counts across samples and its fitted fold change and adjusted p-value

stage.text: testing for differential expression after read counting, before interpreting the hits

mechanism.text: Sidebar uploads and a group picker feed a cached DESeq2 fit. The sidebar's threshold controls then re-classify the fitted results without fitting again, and the summary metrics and the hoverable volcano plot, with its dashed cutoff lines, redraw from that classification.

field.text: differential expression testing of RNA-seq counts in genomics

workflow.name: test each feature for a difference between two groups and call the significant ones

steps.here: Upload a count matrix CSV and a metadata CSV in the sidebar, or click the button that loads the bundled demo set; the main area waits until both tables are present.
Pick the metadata column to compare on, then a target level and a reference level (the reference defaults to the last level, so the two differ).

steps.step: compute a value from the data
steps.here: Run Analysis fits a DESeq2 negative-binomial model and returns log2 fold change, adjusted p-value and -log10(padj) for each gene, dropping genes with missing values.

steps.step: filter to the items that matter
steps.here: A log2 fold-change slider and a padj input in the sidebar mark each gene up, down or not significant, and totals for tested, up and down genes update with them.

steps.step: look over every item at a glance
steps.here: A volcano plot shows fold change against -log10(padj), coloured by call, with dashed lines at the cutoffs; hovering shows a gene's name and values.
Download every gene's statistics and its call as a CSV file.

distinctive: The test is a negative-binomial GLM with multiple-testing-adjusted p-values, set by a design factor and a target-versus-reference contrast.
Calls need both an effect-size cutoff and a significance cutoff, and both are drawn as guide lines on the volcano plot.
The fit is cached, so moving a cutoff re-classifies genes at once without refitting.
The interface text can be switched between two languages from the sidebar.
